data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Android hardware barcode scanners and battery status monitoring.
data.what_it_does: It initializes device-specific scanner interfaces, lets you create custom scan profiles, streams barcode results, and provides battery information for supported Honeywell, Datalogic, Newland, Urovo and Zebra devices.
use_when: You need to use a built‑in hardware scanner on an Android device
You want fine‑grained control over which barcode types are enabled
You need battery status or monitoring from the device
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS, web or desktop
Your device is not in the supported list
strengths: Supports multiple vendors with a single API
Provides stream of scans for reactive UI
weaknesses: Only works on Android and only on specific hardware
Requires manual profile setup for each vendor
data.setup_notes: Call Scanwedge.initialize() before use; no special permissions required beyond normal Android manifest entries for hardware access.
